```{r}
check_value_of_n <- function(x){
  if (x > 0){
    print(paste(x, "Greater than zero"))
  }else{
    print(paste(x, "is less or equal to zero"))
  }
}


check_value_of_n(0)
```


```{r}
check_n <- function(x){
  if (is.na(x)){
    print("Missing value of number to be checked")
  }else if(x > 0){
    print(paste(x, "is greater than zeo"))
  }else{
    print(paste(x, "is less or equal to zero"))
  }
}

check_n(NA)
```


```{r}
# Allowing a function to accept a vector and check for each element
number_sign_4 <- Vectorize(check_n)

number_sign_4(c(6,8,3,0.-4))
```



```{r}

quadratic_function <- function(a, b, c){

  delt = b*b-(4*a*c)
  x1 = (-b +sqrt(delt)) / 2 * a
  x2 = (-b -sqrt(delt)) / 2 * a
  
  print(paste("The value of  x1 is", x1))
  print(paste("The value of  x2 is", x2))
  
}


```
